kattisInstructions: To submit to Kattis, you need to have the submission client and the configuration file downloaded in a folder called .kattis in your home directory.
kattisBrowserNote: Submission result will open in your browser.
cphDescription: A VS Code extension to make competitive programming easier, created by Divyanshu Agrawal
aiDescription: Get a walking companion cat to keep you company during coding.
antivirusDescription: If you are getting SIGTERM or Timed Out, your antivirus may be the problem. Try disabling it or adding the current folder to whitelist.
submitServerFailed: CPH was unable to start the cph-submit server on port {0}. This usually happens another VS Code window was already open. Please close all other VS Code windows and reload this window.
codeforcesInstructions: To submit to codeforces, you need to have the cph-submit browser extension installed, and a browser window open. You can change language ID from VS Code settings.
submitHint: Hint: You can also press Ctrl+Alt+S to submit.
noProblemAssociated: This document does not have a CPH problem associated with it.
supportCPH: If you find CPH useful, please consider supporting.
supportDescription: Your contribution helps support continued development of CPH. CPH is free and open source, thanks to your support.
feedbackDescription: Mind sharing quick feedback in-app? It takes less than a minute and helps me improve CPH!
feedbackReviewed: All feedback is carefully reviewed by the developer.
customCheckerDescription: Custom checker allows you to use a python script to evaluate testcases. CPH will auto-generate temporary files for testcase input and your code output, and pass their paths to your script.
expectedBehavior: Your script will be called with paths to these files as positional arguments. You can read them like this:
exitCodes: Your script shoud exit with code 0 for success (Pass) and non-zero for failure (Fail).
expectedOutputIgnored: Expected output field is ignored because a custom checker is enabled.
argScriptPath: The full filesystem path to your Python checker script.
argInputFile: A temporary file generated by CPH containing the input data for the current testcase.
argOutputFile: A temporary file generated by CPH containing the actual output generated by your code.
nameTooLong: Name must be less than 100 characters
commentTooLong: Comment must be less than 2000 characters (currently {length})
rateCPH: If you find CPH useful, please consider rating it.
rateDescription: Your rating helps other developers find CPH and supports its development.
importCasesDescription: Import testcases from a JSON file. The file must contain a JSON array of objects where each object has "input" and "output" string properties.
jsonRootMustBeArray: The JSON root must be an array.
itemNotValidObject: Item at index {index} is not a valid object.
itemMissingInput: Item at index {index} is missing the "input" string field.
itemMissingOutput: Item at index {index} is missing the "output" string field.
